breakdown.description: The prescribed global x-directed shear traction is replaced by a boundary-normal pressure on the slope
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the sloping-edge load as a global x-directed traction t = (2000, 0) Pa, explicitly stating it is a 'uniform global x-directed traction' rather than a boundary-normal pressure. This matches the ground truth's instruction that 'the horizontal shear traction acts along the sloping boundary but remains a global x-directed traction, not a normal pressure,' and directly contradicts the incomplete prompt's erroneous instruction to treat it as 'a uniform inward normal pressure.'
